title: Edgar Cayce Foundation funded Zahi Hawass

tellings.quote:
So the Edka Casey Foundation
funded Zahawas.

plain: The Edgar Cayce Foundation, a group built around the work of the psychic Edgar Cayce, reportedly paid for Zahi Hawass, the Egyptian archaeologist who later ran the Giza site. A researcher named Jay Anderson says this on the show without naming a source. If true, it would mean a group with mystical interests in Egypt helped shape one of its most powerful archaeologists.
